title: Application of Boston Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, Sec. 94G as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the months of November and December 1988 and January 1989. The fuel charge refelects changes in the prudently incurred. reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company.
